shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular upright slab
anthropomorphic reference (human head/torso in A; schematic arms and belt-like band in B)
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief on a large upright rectangular slab and both allude to a human body — A explicitly as a bearded head and shoulders in profile with earring and headdress, B only through schematic arm-like arcs and a belt-like horizontal band with pendant elements. The difference is fundamental: A is a naturalistic, detailed profile portrait with textured beard, hair and eye, while B shows abstract, geometric and possibly animal motifs distributed over the pillar with no figural face or profile at all.
